nodes.name: Batch Document Check Trigger
nodes.notes: MANUAL/BATCH ENTRY POINT - run after the applicant has finished uploading. Accepts case_id plus either files_json or a SharePoint folder reference, then processes the whole batch.

parameters.query:
SELECT case_id, applicant_id, primary_contact_name, primary_contact_email, folder_root_id
FROM car_cases
WHERE case_id = $1
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Postgres: Load Case For Batch
nodes.notes: CASE LOOKUP - loads contact details and folder_root_id so the manual batch can run from only a case_id when needed.

nodes.name: Prepare Batch Request
nodes.notes: BATCH NORMALISER - combines trigger fields with case data and decides whether to process an explicit file list or list the SharePoint upload folder.

nodes.name: IF: Files Provided?
nodes.notes: ROUTING GATE - TRUE uses files_json supplied by a dashboard/upload service. FALSE lists the applicant SharePoint upload folder.

nodes.name: Expand Provided Files
nodes.notes: FILE EXPANSION - turns the provided files_json array into one n8n item per uploaded file for DB processing.

nodes.name: SharePoint: List Upload Folder
nodes.notes: SHAREPOINT LIST - lists files in the applicant upload directory when the batch is manually triggered without an explicit files_json payload.

nodes.name: Expand Listed Files
nodes.notes: FILE EXPANSION - filters the SharePoint directory listing to real files and maps Graph metadata into the batch processor shape.

nodes.name: Classify Files
nodes.notes: BATCH CLASSIFIER - classifies every uploaded filename locally. No applicant email is sent here; this only prepares DB updates.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS case_id,
    $2::text AS final_doc_type,
    $3::text AS final_category,
    $4::text AS file_name,
    $5::text AS file_id,
    $6::text AS file_mime_type,
    $7::bigint AS file_size,
    $8::text AS target_subfolder,
    $9::text AS classified_by,
    $10::text AS source,
    $11::text AS classification_confidence
), existing AS (
  SELECT d.id
  FROM car_case_documents d, input i
  WHERE d.case_id = i.case_id
    AND d.file_id = i.file_id
    AND d.status = 'received'
  LIMIT 1
), matched AS (
  SELECT d.id
  FROM car_case_documents d, input i
  WHERE d.case_id = i.case_id
    AND d.status = 'pending'
    AND (d.doc_type = i.final_doc_type OR d.category = i.final_category)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.doc_type = i.final_doc_type THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.id
  LIMIT 1
), updated AS (
  UPDATE car_case_documents d
  SET status = 'received',
      file_name = i.file_name,
      file_id = i.file_id,
      metadata = jsonb_build_object(
        'file_name', i.file_name,
        'file_id', i.file_id,
        'file_mime_type', i.file_mime_type,
        'file_size', i.file_size,
        'doc_type', i.final_doc_type,
        'category', i.final_category,
        'target_subfolder', i.target_subfolder,
        'classified_by', i.classified_by,
        'classification_confidence', i.classification_confidence,
        'source', i.source
      ),
      received_at = now()
  FROM matched m, input i
  WHERE d.id = m.id
  RETURNING d.id
), unmatched_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO car_unmatched_uploads (case_id, file_name, file_id, file_mime_type, classified_as, source, logged_at)
  SELECT i.case_id, i.file_name, i.file_id, i.file_mime_type, i.final_doc_type, i.source, now()
  FROM input i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM car_unmatched_uploads u
      WHERE u.case_id = i.case_id
        AND COALESCE(u.file_id, '') = COALESCE(i.file_id, '')
    )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  i.case_id,
  i.final_doc_type,
  i.final_category,
  i.file_name,
  i.file_id,
  i.file_mime_type,
  i.file_size,
  i.source,
  (SELECT id FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS matched_doc_row_id,
  (SELECT id FROM existing LIMIT 1) AS existing_doc_row_id,
  (SELECT id FROM unmatched_insert LIMIT 1) AS unmatched_upload_id,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 'matched'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) THEN 'already_received'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unmatched_insert) THEN 'unmatched_logged'
    ELSE 'unmatched_existing'
  END AS process_status
FROM input i;

nodes.name: Postgres: Record Batch File
nodes.notes: PER-FILE DB WRITE - for each file, fills one pending checklist row, ignores already-recorded files, or logs unmatched uploads without sending an email.

nodes.name: Aggregate Batch Results
nodes.notes: BATCH AGGREGATION - collapses all per-file DB results into one summary item so the workflow sends only one applicant acknowledgement.

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.case_id, c.applicant_id, c.primary_contact_name, c.primary_contact_email, c.folder_root_id,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.required = true AND d.status = 'received') AS received_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.required = true) AS required_count,
  COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('label', d.label, 'doc_type', d.doc_type)) FILTER (WHERE d.required = true AND d.status = 'pending'), '[]'::json) AS outstanding
FROM car_cases c
LEFT JOIN car_case_documents d ON d.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.case_id = $1
GROUP BY c.case_id;

nodes.name: Postgres: Load Batch Summary
nodes.notes: POST-BATCH CASE SUMMARY - loads the updated checklist counts and outstanding rows after all files have been processed.

nodes.name: Build One Acknowledgement Email
nodes.notes: ONE EMAIL BUILDER - builds a single consolidated acknowledgement covering the whole manual batch, including newly matched, already-on-file, unmatched, and outstanding documents.

nodes.name: Outlook: Send Batch Ack Email
nodes.notes: SINGLE APPLICANT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT - sends exactly one email after the manual batch check completes.

nodes.name: IF: All Required Received?
nodes.notes: COMPLETION CHECK - TRUE when the consolidated batch leaves no required checklist items outstanding.

parameters.query:
UPDATE car_cases
SET status = 'documents_complete'
WHERE case_id = $1 AND status = 'documents_pending'
RETURNING case_id, applicant_id, primary_contact_email, primary_contact_name;

nodes.name: Postgres: Mark Case documents_complete
nodes.notes: STATUS TRANSITION - only changes documents_pending to documents_complete once, so repeated manual batch checks do not re-fire the gate.

nodes.name: IF: Status Transitioned?
nodes.notes: IDEMPOTENCY GUARD - only sends the WF-07 documents_ready signal if this run actually transitioned the case status.

nodes.name: Signal documents_ready
nodes.notes: WF-07 SIGNAL - marks documents_ready after the manual batch check completes all required documents.
